description.text:
Radiant Energy (辉耀能量) is a two-card theme pack that came only in four art sleeve gift boxes, released on 29 March 2024: Pikachu, Zacian, Zamazenta and Eternatus. One card in each pack is one of four made in equal numbers: Ducklett, Galarian Slowpoke and Lickitung with new artwork, or the Stadium Player's Ceremony, whose art shows many Pokémon. The other card is a holo basic Energy with a radiant border, where the type mark and a Poké Ball show faintly in the card face, or a holo Trainer or Pokémon; this first pack has Water and Psychic Energy. With luck it is the Zacian V holo or a black and gold Pokémon.

Each box held one theme pack with black and gold sleeves of its Pokémon, a set of six damage-counter dice, 30 five-card Nine Colours Gathering packs (at least ten each of Friend and Origin) and a black and gold box that keeps cards. Its four main cards are numbered out of 4; the Energy, the full-art Trainers and Pokémon V and VMAX, and the black and gold Pikachu VMAX, Eternatus V and VMAX, Zacian V and Zamazenta V are numbered past it, up to 023.
